episodes.title: Part 1: The Reluctant Priest
episodes.break_rationale: Struggling atheist musician Prabhendu is forced to return to his ancestral Palakkad roots and don the sacred thread as a temple priest to settle debts.
episodes.recap_text: In debt and failing as an independent musician, Prabhendu abandons city life and reluctantly accepts his family's traditional priesthood.
episodes.teaser_next: An eerie midnight ritual in the ancestral shrine introduces an impossible visitor.

episodes.title: Part 2: The Delulu Phenomenon
episodes.break_rationale: Prabhendu encounters the eccentric spirit Delulu/Maya, turning his rigid rationalism upside down.
episodes.recap_text: Prabhendu struggles through temple rituals until a young ghost named Maya begins haunting and communicating exclusively with him.
episodes.teaser_next: Maya insists Prabhendu help her fulfill an unfinished earthly longing before she can cross over.

episodes.title: Part 3: Spirits & Sacred Threads
episodes.break_rationale: Comedic chaos erupts as friend Roopesh suspects Prabhendu is losing his sanity while Maya intervenes in temple pujas.
episodes.recap_text: Prabhendu juggles priestly duties with Maya's unpredictable antics, sparking town gossip and suspicion from Roopesh.
episodes.teaser_next: Maya's past life begins to unravel, revealing a poignant connection to Prabhendu's own musical youth.

episodes.title: Part 4: The Past Awakes
episodes.break_rationale: A shocking revelation regarding Maya's sudden demise brings Saadhya and Prabhendu into emotional conflict.
episodes.recap_text: As Prabhendu investigates Maya's history, buried secrets about family expectations and unfulfilled promises come to light.
episodes.teaser_next: A crucial confrontation at the ancestral temple festival forces Prabhendu to take a stand.

episodes.title: Part 5: Maya's Truth
episodes.break_rationale: The truth about Delulu's boundary between life and death is unveiled during an intense spiritual crossroads.
episodes.recap_text: Prabhendu risks his reputation to perform a unique musical ceremony to bring closure to Maya's lingering spirit.
episodes.teaser_next: The final spiritual transition arrives as Prabhendu confronts his own fears and rediscovers his musical soul.

episodes.title: Part 6: Beyond the Illusion
episodes.break_rationale: Triumphant resolution as Prabhendu finds peace, reconciles his faith with his music, and bids a bittersweet farewell to Maya.
episodes.recap_text: In a moving and humorous climax, Prabhendu harmonizes temple tradition with his musical destiny, transformed by Maya's memory.
episodes.teaser_next: Series finale concludes the supernatural fantasy miniseries cut of Sarvam Maya!
